title: NumPy Vectorized Arithmetic Visualizer
description: Step-by-step visual trace of element-wise multiplication (prices * quantities), scalar scaling (total * 0.10), vector subtraction, 2D scalar addition, and column-specific bonus arithmetic.

steps.explanation: Imports the NumPy numerical computing library under the conventional alias 'np'.
Allocates a 1D NumPy array of product unit prices with shape (3,).
Allocates a 1D NumPy array of corresponding quantities sold with shape (3,). Both shapes match.
Executes prices * quantities element-wise: 100*2=200, 200*3=600, 150*4=600 without any Python for loop.
Broadcasts scalar multiplication (* 0.10) to every item in total_sales: 200*0.1=20.0, 600*0.1=60.0, 600*0.1=60.0.
Subtracts discount array from total_sales element-wise: 200-20=180.0, 600-60=540.0, 600-60=540.0.
Allocates a 2D matrix of student scores with shape (2, 3).
Adds scalar (+ 5) to every single cell in the 2D array simultaneously.
Extracts column 2 (Science: [90, 85]) and adds scalar 10, producing [100, 95] without affecting Maths or English scores.
